bio: Established in a grand town house, EssenCiel is the lovingly created brainchild of a young couple, Niels Brants and Romina Charels. A smart contemporary style, mingling purity and elegance without losing sight of their signature casual vibe, sets the scene. A seat on the patio near the vegetable garden is heavenly in fine weather. Chef Brants deploys the full gamut of his culinary know-how combined with a flair for unearthing fantastic ingredients. He avows a passion for vegetables and the intricate craftsmanship of his unorthodox recipes is part of his hallmark. Our inspectors were most impressed by the culinary experience he created with three versions of gambero rosso.
